page: City page: B2B lead generation New York (/b2b-lead-generation-new-york)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in New York?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to New York work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the New York market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for New York built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with New York buyers, mainly financial services, SaaS, media and professional services firms. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into United States. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in New York. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in New York and send in their working hours. New York is 9.5 hours behind India in summer and 10.5 hours in winter, so meetings usually land in the Indian evening. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for New York buyers?
items.answer: US B2B cold email falls under the CAN-SPAM Act, which does not require prior consent but does require honest sender and subject lines, a postal address in every email and an opt-out honoured within 10 business days. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
